 ACCOMMODATION

Perched up in the sky our Patong luxury accommodations are elegantly appointed to relax and soothe your mood. Starting at a generous 46 sqm all rooms are spacious and most offer magnificent sea views. Feel at home with top of the range amenities including wireless internet and a handy smartphone for your personal use during your stay.

DELUXE ROOM

The Deluxe is delightfully designed to give you space to unwind in the cool air with comfortable furnishings and beautiful nature inspired decor.

EXPLORER
 
DELUXE SEAVIEW

The amazing azure blue sea and sky views are always with you, whether on the balcony enjoying the fresh air, relaxing on the comfortable bed or even in bathtub! The tropical vista sets the mood for a chilled and carefree stay.

EXPLORER
 
HONEYMOON SEAVIEW

Fall in love all over again in the exquisite honeymoon seaview room. The uninterrupted sea views are sublime, overlooking Patong Beach and forested mountains.

EXPLORER
 
GRAND DELUXE SEAVIEW

Indulge in a relaxing soak in the bathtub overlooking the spectacular tropical panorama at the Grand Deluxe Seaview. This contemporary style room is more spacious at 51 sqm and has far reaching views from two sides thanks to its corner position.

EXPLORER
 
ROMANCE ROOM WITH OCEAN VIEW

The uninterrupted sea views are sublime, overlooking Patong Beach and forested mountains. The king-size bed is beautifully draped for romantic moments, there are plenty of modern amenities at your fingertips,

EXPLORER
 
FAMILY SEAVIEW

We are a family friendly resort near Patong and have the perfect room for parents and children to stay together in comfort. This spacious 71 sqm room features a king-size bed and a bunk bed sleeping up to two adults and two children.

EXPLORER
 
JUNIOR SUITE WITH OCEAN VIEW

EXPLORER
 
DOUBLE POOL ACCESS WITH OCEAN VIEW

Pool lovers will adore this double pool access room in Phuket which has a wonderful sundeck and dip pool right outside your window. Feel carefree with the spectacular Sea view that beckons you outdoors to swim and relax under the tropical sun.

EXPLORER
 
DUPLEX POOL VILLA

This contemporary two-storey villa at Kalima is the ultimate tropical hideaway! Stay in total comfort at this heavenly Patong pool villa for families or couples nestled on the hillside overlooking the magnificent Andaman Sea.

EXPLORER
 
PRIVATE POOL VILLA - ONE BEDROOM

Share the ultimate luxury pool villa in Phuket with your family and friends in our exquisite one and two bedroom villa. Luxurious furnishings, high tech amenities and facilities to relax, dine and entertain are all included.

EXPLORER
 
PRIVATE POOL VILLA - TWO BEDROOM

Share the ultimate luxury pool villa in Phuket with your family and friends in our exquisite one and two bedroom villa. Luxurious furnishings, high tech amenities and facilities to relax, dine and entertain are all included.

Shoremagic: Where Splendor Unfolds
Welcome to The Little Shore Khao Lak by Katathani

where the harmonious blend of modern luxury, celebratory moments,
lively vibes, and a romantic atmosphere creates an enchanting seaside
paradise that exudes tranquility and relaxation.



Nestled along the pristine shores of Khao Lak, The Little Shore by
Katathani invites you to embark on a journey of romance, celebration, and
rejuvenation like no other. With the shimmering azure waters of the
Andaman Sea as your backdrop and lush tropical gardens surrounding
you, prepare to immerse yourself in the ultimate escape. Whether you're
celebrating a special occasion, honeymooning, or simply seeking a
tranquil retreat with your loved one, The Little Shore Khao Lak promises
an unforgettable experience filled with moments of pure bliss, serenity,
and lively vibes.

THE ACCOMMODATION

MORE DETAIL
THE ROMANCE
Embrace Romance, Craft Timeless Memories, and Escape to Paradise.
ROMANTIC DINNER
 

Indulge in an intimate and enchanting evening with our Private
Romantic Seaside 6-Course Dinner Package, exclusively designed
for just the two of you. Set against the backdrop of the shimmering
sea and under a blanket of stars, this unforgettable dining
experience promises to kindle the flames of romance.

 
MORE DETAIL
SURPRISE PACKAGE
 

Make your special moments even more extraordinary with our
Surprise Package, tailor-made for occasions like birthdays,
anniversaries, or unforgettable proposals. At The Little Shore Khao
Lak by Katathani, we understand the importance of celebrating
life's milestones in a unique and memorable way.

 
MORE DETAIL
WEDDING
 

"Introducing 'The Happily Ever After' Seaside Wedding Package,
where your love story meets the breathtaking beauty of the sea. At
The Little Shore at Khao Lak, we specialize in crafting
unforgettable moments, and your wedding day should be nothing
short of magical.

 
MORE DETAIL
THE
FACILITIES
Beachfront Pool

Experience seaside luxury at our Beachfront Pool, where the sparkling pool meets the endless sea. Relax in a private cabana or beachfront lounger.

The Artisan Boutique & Cafe

Discover our Artisan boutique, a sanctuary of handcrafted wonders tucked away within our resort.

The Fit & Firm

Our gym boasts top-of-the-line equipment, ensuring that every fitness goal is within reach. From cardio machines to free weights, our well-appointed facilities cater to all fitness levels.

The Sands Facilities

Guests of The Little Shore will enjoy unrestricted access to the exceptional facilities at The Sands, our sister resort.

The Little Octopus Kids' Club

Step into the magical world of The Little Octopus Kids' Club, where young adventurers embark on a journey of imagination and joy.

air, land, or sea must complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card
(TDAC) online before arrival.

Welcome to Crest Resort & Pool Villas in Patong, Phuket.

Crest Resort & Pool Villas is a contemporary hilltop resort above Patong, offering a calm and private setting surrounded by tropical greenery.

Designed with sustainability in mind, the resort blends eco-friendly practices with modern comfort, respecting the natural landscape while ensuring a relaxed stay.

Located away from the busy beachfront, Crest offers a peaceful atmosphere with sea views from selected areas, spacious rooms, and private pool villas in an elevated environment.

Ideal for travelers seeking privacy, space, and a more mindful Patong Resort Phuket escape.

As a Patong resort Phuket travellers choose for privacy and panoramic sea views, Crest sits on the hillside minutes from the beach while staying above the noise. New to the island? Start with our Phuket hotels guide to the best areas to stay.

Is Crest Resort Right for You?

Crest Resort & Pool Villas is ideal for guests looking for:

A quiet, private resort environment
Panoramic ocean and sunset views
Private pool villas and spacious sea-view rooms
Romantic escapes, honeymoons, and relaxed stays
A peaceful location close to, but not inside, Patong
Resort Highlights
Hilltop resort with panoramic sea views
144 rooms and private pool villas
Infinity swimming pool with sea views
Spacious outdoor sun deck overlooking the Andaman Sea
Prima Wellness & Spa
Fitness centre with private Muay Thai classes available
Multiple dining venues and bars
Buggy service throughout the resort
Convenient access to Patong Beach and Phuket Town
